source.title: RDC supervisor: correggere l’invio del prompt dal composer corrente
source.objective: ChatGPT RDC supervisor: send_message() is also stale against the current ChatGPT composer. After correctly stopping a stuck generation and filling "continua" into the live ProseMirror [contenteditable=true][role=textbox], the supervisor failed to submit it because its composer/send selectors do not match the current UI; the text remained in the composer until a direct Enter keypress was used. Update _composer()/send_message() selectors and add a live E2E assertion that a nudge actually creates a new user turn, not merely fills the composer.
